description: A seller's Printlooper shop: its link, how many products are live, and whether Shopify is connected. product_feed_url is a public, read only list of the live products for a site the seller runs themselves: show them there and link each Buy button to the product url, where the buyer pays on Printlooper. The look, logo and about text are edited in the shop editor on Printlooper. Needs a connected Printlooper account.
name: get_my_store
title: My shop
